THE ANSWER, computed: det(Cartan matrix of E6) = 3 so the centre of the simply connected form is Z/3; and the fundamental weights' root-lattice membership is omega_1 NO, omega_2 YES, omega_3 NO, omega_4 YES, omega_5 NO, omega_6 NO -- so the 27's highest weight is NOT in the root lattice, the centre Z/3 ACTS NONTRIVIALLY on the 27, and THE 27 IS A REPRESENTATION OF THE SIMPLY CONNECTED E6 ONLY: the adjoint form E6/Z3 HAS NO 27, its representations being exactly those of trivial central character (78, 650, ...). WHY THIS CLOSES THE HATCH RATHER THAN MERELY ANSWERING IT: the hatch was an escape route -- work in the adjoint form where non-toral rank-2 subgroups exist and rank 4 might be reachable -- but ESCAPING TO THE ADJOINT FORM COSTS YOU THE 27, THE VERY OBJECT WHOSE CHIRALITY WAS THE ENTIRE POINT. ## How to falsify any of this

1. Every closure names an **escape hatch** -- the computation that would reopen it. Pick a
   door in `CLOSED_DOORS.md`, run its hatch; the door holds or it does not.
2. Every PROVED arc names its **test locks**. Run them.
3. The gates (`python3 scripts/gates/gates.py`) enforce the governance invariants, and each
   was verified by deliberate breakage -- a gate never observed to fail is not a gate.

You do not need to read the record to check the programme. That is the point of this page.
